credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Light brown cardboard rectangular box containing 20 varnished wooden handled paintbrushes in three rubber band bundles, brushes are various thickness and imprinted with the manufacturers logos: El Greco 780 USA, M. Grumbacher "Mussini" and UMB "Rubens".  One (1) broken paint brush handle, no ferrule or bristles.  Handwritten in pencil on the lid of the box is the word " Brushes".
